name: cervical screening overview
title: Cervical screening: who is screened and how the sample is taken, then the primary HPV test result decides the next step: HPV negative returns in 5 years, HPV 16/18 goes to colposcopy, other high-risk HPV is triaged by reflex cytology; the HPV vaccine prevents but does not replace screening

root.title: Cervical screening: the PRIMARY HPV TEST result decides the next step
lines: WHO: any ASYMPTOMATIC person with a cervix who has EVER been sexually active, from ≈ AGE 25
SAMPLE: provider-collected (speculum + broom/brush) OR self-collected vaginal swab
test for high-risk HPV FIRST · cytology (LBC) only triages a positive · inadequate sample → repeat

groups.title: SCREEN: the HPV result picks the branch
lines: HPV is the cause: test for it directly · 16/18 carry the highest cancer risk

head: h
HPV negative
no high-risk HPV
first: HPV's high NEGATIVE predictive value makes long intervals safe

head: h
Normal or LOW-grade cytology
normal (NILM) · atypical squamous cells (ASC-US) · LSIL
most RESOLVE on their own
first: may already be CIN 3+ → consider IMMEDIATE colposcopy

head: h
HIGH-grade or glandular cytology
ASC-H · HSIL · atypical glandular cells (AGC) · adenocarcinoma in situ (AIS)
first: an HSIL left untreated could progress to cancer, usually ≥ 10 years later
then: before it can become cancer: the point of screening

head: h
HPV vaccine
BEST at 11–12: higher immune response, before exposure

panels.title: Taking the sample
items: ThinPrep: do NOT leave the broom in the vial · SurePath: may be left
label: full name, date of birth, collection date · expired vial = rejected
self-collected: for UNDER- + NEVER-screened; HPV test sensitive enough on vaginal cells
not for symptomatic people · include the transformation zone

panels.title: Reading the reflex cytology
items: LOW grade → repeat in 1 year: NILM (95% of results) · ASC-US · LSIL
HIGH grade → colposcopy: HSIL · ASC-H · squamous cell carcinoma

panels.title: Why HPV first, cytology second
items: HPV more SENSITIVE: finds high-grade lesions earlier → 5-year interval
BUT lower positive predictive value: HPV + ≠ a lesion, so cytology triages
low-risk HPV 6, 11 = warts + LSIL, NOT cancer
